items.text: At the deepest level, reality is:

options.A: A multiplicity of genuinely separate things
options.C: Both—unity at one level, multiplicity at another
options.E: A unified whole in which separation is illusion

items.text: A mystic claims "all is one" and separation is illusion. A physicist says there are distinctly separate particles. Who's right?

options.C: Both—they describe different levels of reality

items.text: The experience of fundamental unity is:

options.B: An interesting brain state, not metaphysically significant
options.C: Genuinely uncertain—could be insight or artifact
options.D: Probably a genuine insight into the nature of reality
options.E: A genuine insight into the fundamental nature of reality
